title: Debounce
summary: debounce(fn, t) returns a function that schedules fn to run t ms after the latest call, cancelling any prior pending invocation; invokes with the arguments of the most recent call.
outputFormat: fn called once per quiet interval with latest arguments
edgeRules: a call during the wait resets the timer

examples.output: one invocation at 200 ms with the 100 ms arguments
